data.name: Nahrawi
data.gender_notes: Nahrawi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nahrawi is derived from the Arabic word 'Nahr' which means 'stream' or 'river'. It symbolizes the never-ending flow of life and blessings. The name Nahrawi carries the meaning “Stream or river” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Nahrawi usually hope their child will grow to embody stream or river and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nahrawi total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
